text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's another ordinary day, and I decide to
take a stroll through the
academy. As I
pass by the student dormitory, however—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'm so, so
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the halls of the Ritto dormitory, I
hear somebody scream, followed by what
sounds like Matikanefukukitaru furiously

apologizing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Somebody... Please help...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! Perfect timing!
So I'm in a bit
of a kerfuffle... Do you
think you could
lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-wait! Hear me out! You need to help
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, we're in this together! The great
Shiraoki led you to me for a
reason! Follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without even waiting for my response,
Matikanefukukitaru grabs my
hand and
leads me to one of the dorm rooms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look into the room, but my vision is
obscured by a giant mountain of garbage.
The scream from earlier must have come
from the now
buried roommate.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
None of this is trash! It's all my lucky
charms! I've spent half my life
curating this
magnificent collection!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everything here is too valuable for me to
just throw away! But my treasure mound
kind of toppled over and may have
completely
swallowed my friend...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's fine though! If I keep this up,
I'll have
enough stuff to cover all of
Tracen
Academy! Or well... I think so, at least.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Whaaaaat?! How could you say
something so blasphemous with such a
straight face?! I can't throw any of this
away! Outta the
question!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You know these are my lucky charms,
right? The good fortune I receive from
everything here is why I'm at this academy
in the first place! Throw it all away?! I
would never!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I guess so... I mean, it's already consumed its first victim...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... It pains me to admit it,
but if the trainer sent to me by the
great Shiraoki
tells me so, I suppose there's not much I
can do...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right,
then. I'll get rid of some of it.
Just a tiny bit though! Only
the stuff I
don't need!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After helping Matikanefukukitaru gather
the lucky items she deems
unnecessary, we
head to the incinerator behind the school
building.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Awww, man... I can't believe I'm burning
my lucky items—even a tiny
portion of
them. How depressing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Okay, I think I'm ready... Where should we start?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, that charm helped me reach the top
eight in a ball tournament back in
elementary school! Are you mad?! We
can't start with
something so important!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No way! Back when I was little, I almost
got run over by a tricycle. That doll got
run over in my stead! Who knows what
would happen if
we burned it?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's the pudding cup from when I was
four and opened one by
myself for the
very first time! Burning that is out of
question!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Argh, I can't do this! I'm begging you,
please don't make me get rid of
my stuff...
I'll do anything, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Matikanefukukitaru fall to her
knees in despair, I decide that
burning her
possessions might not be for the best and
take a step back from the incinerator.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Every one of these lucky items is dear to
me... But at the same time, taking them
back to my room would just lead to
someone else getting
hurt...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Any suggestions? I'll
give you a wisdom charm.
Let's think about
it together...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You? Hold onto my stuff for me? Would
you really?! I'd really
appreciate it! I don't
mind sharing luck with you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... What a huge relief... I was
worried for a second there. Throwing away
even one of my lucky items would be... I-I
don't want
to think about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y'know how I said I'd appreciate you
holding onto my stuff for me earlier?
Well... I do,
but... would it be okay for me
to stop by once a week to see my things?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I'm so glad it's you
who's watching my stuff for
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, with that said... Good night! Take
good care of my lucky items
for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru bids her belongings
farewell and takes her leave, waving her
white handkerchief as she reluctantly
returns to her dorm
room.
